BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-14 commit 3bd3bb1. 29 content files + 9 ADRs. Methodology v1.7. STAGES DONE THROUGH 18.10. Spine: 25 stages (18 + inserted 16.5, 18.5-18.10).

READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST. ADR-0009 three provenance layers in force (Main Argument / Manuscript Voice / RESEARCHER'S COMMENTARY).

STAGE 18.10 = 00v-colossians-2-shadow-and-body.md. Passage used in OPPOSITE directions with equal confidence; began with NEITHER, and began BEFORE v.16.

- Argument starts with MESSIAH not food. 2:8 targets 'philosophy and empty deceit, according to HUMAN TRADITION'. By 2:11 circumcision/immersion/death/resurrection already woven together. V.16 is NOT an isolated dietary ruling.
- *** THE CHEIROGRAPHON BRAKE (open q 47) *** 'The Torah was nailed to the cross' REPLACES PAUL'S NOUN. Col 2:14 Greek is CHEIROGRAPHON — a handwritten certificate of DEBT (CJB 'bill of charges'), NOT nomos. Same shape of error as reading 'planet Earth' into ge, or citing CJB's 'legalism' as though the Greek said it. WHAT the cheirographon IS = live question, unresolved (debt certificate / record of transgressions / the indictment). Recorded chiefly as a GUARD: whatever it means, the substitution must not be made silently.
- 2:15 is COSMIC VICTORY (forgiveness, debt cancelled, rulers disarmed). V.16's 'therefore' hangs off THAT. The paragraph is not a menu.
- FESTIVAL/NEW MOON/SABBATH is a recognizable TANAKH CALENDRICAL FORMULA (1 Chr 23:31, Ezek 45:17, Hosea 2:11) — annual/monthly/weekly. Paul is using biblical sacred-calendar language, not naming random holidays.
- *** FOURTH CONFIRMED VERSIFICATION OFFSET: CJB numbers ESV's HOSEA 2:11 as 2:13 *** (+2 in Hosea 2, from Hebrew numbering counting ESV 1:10-11 as 2:1-2). Surfaced same way as prior three (direct fetch returned a different verse). Prior offsets: Jeremiah 31 (+1), Zechariah 2:6, Psalms superscription (+1).

- 2:17 IS LITERALLY SKIA -> SOMA = SHADOW -> BODY. ESV's 'substance' is interpretive; CJB/RVR1960 keep 'body'. REMARKABLY CLOSE TO THE MODEL REACHED INDEPENDENTLY through Leviticus/Acts/Hebrews — WE ARRIVED CARRYING IT, NOT MANUFACTURING IT TO FIT.
- *** AND V.17 DOES NOT ANSWER THE QUESTION IT RAISES *** A shadow, on the body's arrival, might become: meaningless / obsolete / unnecessary / STILL INFORMATIVE / STILL OBSERVABLE BUT NO LONGER CONSTITUTIVE / TRANSFORMED IN MEANING / VALUABLE PRECISELY BECAUSE IT REVEALS THE SHAPE OF THE REALITY CASTING IT. NOT EQUIVALENT PROPOSITIONS. NONE OF THEM IS CONTAINED IN THE WORD SKIA. Do NOT silently add 'therefore sinful to observe'. Do NOT silently add 'therefore obligatory exactly as before'.
- TON MELLONTON (open q 48): 'a shadow of THE THINGS TO COME' — written AFTER the cross. If everything signified had been exhausted at the cross, why future-oriented language? BRAKE: mello participles function broadly; NOT YET AN ARGUMENT. But earns the question: did Paul understand some realities signified by Israel's sacred calendar as STILL AWAITING FULFILLMENT? Potentially significant for eschatology (Passover, Firstfruits, Pentecost, Trumpets, Atonement, Tabernacles). Deliberately not jumped to.
- WHO IS JUDGING (open q 49): READING A discontinuity (Judaizers criticizing Gentiles for NOT observing) vs READING B continuity (ascetic/syncretistic teachers criticizing HOW they observe). 2:18-23 OPPONENT PROFILE: asceticism / WORSHIP OF ANGELS / going on in detail about VISIONS / 'Do not handle, Do not taste, Do not touch' / explicitly 'according to HUMAN PRECEPTS AND TEACHINGS'. A MUCH STRANGER RELIGIOUS ENVIRONMENT than ordinary Torah observance. Resembles Mark 7 (commandment of God vs tradition of men) and 1 Tim 4 (forbid marriage + require abstinence) — recurring Pauline concern with RELIGIOUSLY MOTIVATED DEPRIVATION ELEVATED INTO SPIRITUAL RIGHTEOUSNESS.
- *** BRAKE RUNS BOTH WAYS — THIRD CONSECUTIVE STAGE *** Continuity readers CANNOT say 'nothing here concerns Torah' — v.17 plainly calls food/drink + festival + new moon + Sabbath a shadow whose body is Messiah. Discontinuity readers CANNOT say 'therefore Torah was nailed to the cross' — Paul didn't use nomos and the opponents include clearly extra-biblical practices. BOTH SIMPLISTIC SYSTEMS FAIL TO ABSORB ALL THE EVIDENCE.
- WORKING MODEL (not conclusion): 'Because believers possess the reality in Messiah, they must not permit others to establish spiritual condemnation over them concerning food, sacred times, ascetic restrictions, visionary experiences, or human religious regulations. The biblical calendar itself possesses shadow-character because its ultimate reality belongs to Messiah.' DELIBERATELY ANSWERS NEITHER 'therefore observe Sabbath' NOR 'therefore don't'.
- ROMANS 14:6 adds a Pauline principle: calendar observance can be performed UNTO YAHWEH without functioning as justification or grounds for judging. BUT Paul does NOT say 'Sabbath' — Romans 14 is still NOT the Sabbath-abolition passage (q34 stands).
- MAY EXPLAIN ACTS 21: if Torah's institutions are shadows whose reality is Messiah, participation needn't deny the reality. Paul calls Messiah 'OUR PASSOVER' — recognizing the reality doesn't make the Exodus false. THE REALITY MAKES THE PATTERN MORE INTELLIGIBLE. Participating might not constitute 'returning from reality to shadow' UNLESS treated as a replacement for Messiah, a means of justification, or a rival source of redemption. SAME HYPOTHESIS as 18.9 section 26, now with a SECOND INDEPENDENT LINE OF SUPPORT.

*** NEW FORMAL RULE — FULFILLMENT != ABOLITION (00b + methodology v1.7) *** A METHODOLOGICAL rule, not a theological conclusion. ASK WHAT FULFILLMENT DOES TO EACH PARTICULAR PATTERN. 'IT WAS A SHADOW' CANNOT FUNCTION AS A UNIVERSAL ABOLITION ALGORITHM. Already demonstrated different: SACRIFICE (once-for-all fundamentally changes the system) / CIRCUMCISION (not imposed on Gentiles, heart circumcision central) / PASSOVER (Paul STILL uses the language to explain Messiah, 1 Cor 5:7) / SABBATH, FESTIVALS, CLEAN FOODS all unresolved. COMPANION TO COVENANTAL TRANSMISSION — that asks what happens to a command as the covenant people expands; this asks what fulfillment does to a pattern. Neither answerable by category label alone.
ALSO RESTATED: THE LEXICAL-SUBSTITUTION GUARD — do not replace an author's noun with your category.

*** NEXT STAGE: SABBATH — STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT FROM EVERYTHING TESTED SO FAR ***
- GENESIS 2:2-3: Yahweh rested, BLESSED the seventh day and MADE IT HOLY — before Abraham, Israel, Sinai, Levi, Moses
- EXODUS 16:23, 29-30: Israel observes seventh-day rest BEFORE the Ten Commandments are proclaimed at Sinai
- EXODUS 20:11: Sinai grounds Sabbath NOT MERELY IN SINAI BUT IN CREATION ITSELF
- EXODUS 20:10: extends the rest to 'THE FOREIGNER STAYING WITH YOU INSIDE THE GATES' — THE GER AGAIN
- MARK 2:27: 'The Sabbath was made for ANTHROPOS (man/humankind), not man for the Sabbath' — NOT 'made for Israel'
- YET PAUL CALLS IT A SHADOW (Col 2:16-17)
THE QUESTION: if Sabbath is rooted in creation before Sinai, incorporated into the Ten Commandments at Sinai, practiced by Yeshua, called a shadow by Paul, and appears again in prophetic/eschatological contexts — WHAT EXACTLY DOES MESSIAH FULFILL OR CHANGE ABOUT IT? Considerably harder than 'do Christians have to keep Saturday?' — which is precisely why it's the right question.
STILL QUEUED AFTER: Stage 18 PROVISIONAL VERDICT (what the evidence strongly establishes / leans toward / remains genuinely uncertain / AND WHAT CANNOT RESPONSIBLY BE CLAIMED).

COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

SEQUENCE NOTE (ADR-0007 demonstration): 00r was written AFTER 00q but is numbered Stage 16.5 because the spine records ARGUMENT order while file letters record CREATION order. Nothing in Stage 17 was rewritten to pretend this came first. The two architectures are allowed to disagree — that is why both exist.

Vault standard is Yeshua HaMashiach (not YahuShua) — user is aware of/has used the YahuShua transliteration but explicitly decided 2026-08-08 to keep Yeshua as the vault's standing term. Do not silently switch if it comes up again — this was a deliberate choice, not an oversight.
